annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions on the 'Digital Europe programme (2021-2027)'
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions on the 'Digital Europe programme (2021-2027)'
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 86
annotation.summary_en: European Committee of the Regions opinion on the Commission's proposed Digital Europe programme 2021-2027. It proposes amendments stressing multi-level governance, regional Digital Innovation Hubs, data quality, digital skills and AI. Robotics is only mentioned in passing; no embodied-AI governance content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Digital Innovation Hubs should be able to be run by consortia, with a target of a hub in every region.
Programme should cover multi-level governance, with cities and regions central to implementation.
Data quality and integrity measures needed for AI-based public services, with privacy and security safeguards.
Advanced digital skills funding should be gender responsive.
Proposal complies with subsidiarity and proportionality.
